sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 764 x 522 x 427 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

L-Acoustics page read 2026-11-12: "(W x H x D) 764 mm / 427 mm / 522 mm", 35 kg net, "IN: 1 x 4-point speakON" and "LINK: 1 x 4-point speakON" (NL4 or NL8 not named: a 4-point speakON is speakon-nl4), "1 handle, 8 corner stops and 2 ground runners", a flush two-point rigging system, 1 x 15 in LF and 1 x 3 in HF compression driver. The page gives no plan taper or splay, so the shape is a plain rounded box; the one handle and the corner stops have no stated place and are not modelled. Rear positions are guesses; the corner radius and the baffle layout are our estimate.
